name: AuxPair.descentsVanish_of_reflectionSum
summary: By density it suffices to treat data v_P tensor (named coset indicator at the places of O) and the bilinear pairing C_z(y') of a coset indicator centred at z with a form y'. The transport lemma lv: moving the centre by an integral element 1 + A B^T changes y' into (prod psi)^(-1) chosenGLRep(s) y'. For each place an annihilator l of the stacked matrix (z, t) is chosen. If all iota-column residues of all l vanish, z is moved to the inclusion matrix and the Upsilon-datum computation (h0) shows C_z(y) = 0: the residue datum Psi is a sum over a finite set F of coset representatives q (with Psi(q) != 0) of Psi(q) times the coset indicator of q, every term Psi(q) C_q(y) equals Psi(z) C_z(y), so h0 gives |F| Psi(z) C_z(y) = 0, and F is nonempty because Psi(z) != 0. Otherwise some row c has nonzero residues m(c, j): at a chosen place, summing lv over the reflections 1 + x m^T gives the reflection sum, which kills y (hM); at a twist place, a single reflection of determinant t with psi(t) not 1 multiplies C_z(y) by psi(t)^(-1), so C_z(y) = 0 (hQ).
